STRATEGY_1.name: Trend Pullback Continuation
conditions: Best used during active liquidity windows: London 09:00–13:30 Zurich time, and NY 14:30–17:30 Zurich time.
Avoid Asia session (01:00–08:59 Zurich) unless a strong pre-existing trend is already established.
structureState should be non-zero, indicating directional bias on 30m.
EMA50_slope_30m should align with the structure direction.
pullbackRatio ideally between 0.3 and 0.6, indicating a healthy retracement.
marketRegime should favor TREND rather than EXPANSION.
If breakoutScore or sweepScore dominate strongly, this strategy becomes less appropriate.

STRATEGY_2.name: Liquidity Sweep Reversal
conditions: Best used during NY session 14:30–17:30 Zurich time, especially during London-NY overlap.
Can also appear late London session 11:30–13:30 if liquidity has built up.
Avoid Asia session unless an extreme liquidity event occurs.
Absolute sweepScore should be meaningfully elevated.
acceptanceTime should remain low, indicating rejection rather than acceptance.
Market should not be in strong continuation expansion.
Structure can be TREND or RANGE, but the rejection must dominate.

STRATEGY_3.name: Session Breakout Expansion
conditions: Best used early London session 09:00–11:00 Zurich time.
Also valid during NY open 14:30–16:00 during volatility expansion.
Avoid low-volatility Asia session.
Absolute breakoutScore should be meaningfully elevated.
acceptanceTime should indicate continued trading beyond the breakout level.
marketRegime should favor EXPANSION.
Strong volatility expansion increases confidence.

decision_framework: First evaluate if the current time fits the preferred timing window of a strategy.
Then evaluate whether breakoutScore or sweepScore dominate the environment.
Then evaluate structureState, EMA slope and pullbackRatio alignment.
Select the strategy that best probabilistically fits the current environment.
If no strategy clearly dominates, prefer Trend Pullback when structureState is non-zero.
